caption: The drawing shows a painted wooden statue standing on a square pedestal. The statue depicts a male figure with dark brown skin, wearing a green and yellow feathered headdress and a red long-sleeved shirt. Over the shirt, he has a yellow scarf or sash draped across his torso, and a green fringe skirt. The figure is holding several items: in his left hand, he grasps a rectangular brown box with what appear to be cigars inside, and in his right hand, he holds another small rectangular box and a single cigar. The figure also has yellow bands around his knees and ankles, and he stands barefoot on the pedestal. The pedestal is cream-colored with black edging and has the word "CIGARS" written in large black letters on the front. A decorative blue swirl is above the text. On the right side of the pedestal, a smaller sign reads "Cigars and Cozys" in smaller brown letters. The background of the drawing is plain and single-toned, without any additional objects or scenery.
title: Wooden Indian
